scope: Proposition 4.6 (Least-aspect limiting extremizer) of the manuscript “Bochner–Riesz multipliers in three dimensions” (preprints/Bochner-Riesz-Multipliers-in-Three-Dimensions-September-24-2026/Bochner-Riesz-Multipliers-in-Three-Dimensions-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 078 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ea18d159eefcdc7f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 23-24. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exists a saturated sequence at duration one with b = 0, endpoint aspect e = m, and horizon 1 + m, where m ≥ 0 is the least aspect of any 23 such saturated sequence. One may moreover require Yj conditional on Xj to be homogeneous for a prescribed countable list of finite pairs (Xj, Yj), provided that for each fixed j there is 0 ≤ Aj < ∞, independent of ϵ, such that |Yj| ≤ ϵ−Aj for all sufficiently small ϵ. No cardinality bound is imposed on Xj, which may include the exact particle T.
